candidate.impact: unauthenticated heap corruption and conditional IPP service denial of service

firmware_packages.relationship: published CVE-2026-9211 fixed boundary; vulnerable component unchanged
later sibling release; independently dynamically reproduced

dynamic_evidence.effect: 257-byte URI reaches request-object strcpy, corrupts heap, and terminates ippd
256-byte header value reaches header-node strcpy, corrupts heap, and terminates ippd
133-byte URI controls a subsequently dereferenced data pointer
257-byte URI terminates genuine RAXE300 ippd and removes TCP/631 listener

reason_overlap_is_disfavored: The public attack pattern is an HTTP request-smuggling issue, not an IPP parser overflow.
The RAX30 release identified as the CVE-2026-9211 fixed boundary retains the exact vulnerable ippd binary.
A later RAX30 release retains the same binary and independently reproduces both IPP corruption paths.
published_overlap_assessment.remaining_limit: RAXE300 V1.0.10.72 is documented but its package was not publicly retrievable; private or embargoed duplicate status cannot be excluded.

classification.zero_day_candidate: apparent and strongly distinct from CVE-2026-9211, pending current-image or vendor duplicate validation
